item.title: Version 1.3.88
item.description:
- Gallery Manager now installs as a normal app in /Applications and updates itself with Sparkle: it checks the release feed in the background, downloads signed updates and installs them on relaunch. App menu → Check for Updates… checks immediately.
- Updates are verified with an EdDSA signature, so only builds signed with your key are accepted.
- New Scripts/release-app.sh builds, signs, uploads to github.com/xbasiciggy/gallery-manager-releases and updates the feed in one command.
